name: lab-support-bridge
description: Receive LAB customer questions and return grounded replies through the authenticated support bridge.

interface.longDescription: Support signed-in LAB customers using current resource, booking, tariff, payment and loyalty data. Receive question events, read the request-scoped business context, and publish a concise answer back to the customer. This plugin cannot change bookings, payments, accounts or maintenance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start LAB customer support in Work/Cloud: subscribe to lab.assistant.question.created, read each question context, check relevant current customer data, and publish the grounded answer to LAB.
